q1.a: Only with the patient's consent, encrypted, and with configurable retention. You can purge it at any time.

q2.q: Does the AI submit the claim form on its own?
q2.a: No. Human-in-the-loop is mandatory: the note and the form only move forward after your approval.

q3.q: Does it work for my specialty?
q3.a: Yes. There are editable note templates by specialty, and the clinical vocabulary adapts.

q4.q: What about integration with my electronic medical record?
q4.a: We connect to PEPs and payers via integrations. TISS is a market module (Brazil).

q5.q: Is it available in other languages?
q5.a: Yes — pt-BR, English, Chinese, and French from day one.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Auronis Health is an AI clinical scribe: it turns visit audio into structured medical records and TISS claims. This policy explains how we handle personal data on the site and platform — transparently and in line with the LGPD and, where applicable, the GDPR.

scope.h: Who we are and what this policy covers
scope.p: This policy applies to auronishealth.com and to the Auronis Health platform. In services provided to clinics, the contracting clinic is the controller of patient data; Auronis acts as processor, handling data strictly under the contract and the clinic’s instructions.

data.p: Account data (name, email, professional license, role in the clinic), platform usage data and, on the clinic’s behalf, visit health data: audio, transcript, structured record and billing information (TISS claims). Health data is sensitive data and receives the strictest safeguards described here.

use.p: We use data to deliver the service: transcribe the visit, structure the record, verify claims before submission and run the clinical copilot. We do not sell personal data, show no advertising, and never use identifiable patient audio or records to train AI models.

sharing.p: We share data only with subprocessors required to operate the service (cloud hosting and AI inference providers), under contracts with confidentiality and security obligations equivalent to ours, and when required by law or a competent authority.

security.p: AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS in transit, role-based access control (RBAC), access audit trails and mandatory human review (human-in-the-loop) before any clinical document is signed or submitted.

retention.p: Clinical data is retained for the period defined in the clinic contract and by legal medical-record retention obligations. When the contract ends, we return or delete data as instructed by the controller.

rights.p: Data subjects may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, anonymization, portability and deletion under LGPD art. 18 (and the GDPR where applicable). Patients should address requests to their clinic (the controller); we support the clinic in responding. Reach our DPO at privacidade@auronishealth.com.

cookies.p: We use essential cookies only: authenticated session and theme/language preferences. No advertising cookies, no third-party trackers.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of the Auronis Health platform — an AI clinical scribe that generates structured records and TISS claims from visit audio — contracted by clinics and health professionals.

object.p: Auronis Health provides AI-assisted clinical documentation as a service (SaaS). By creating an account or using the platform you agree to these terms and to the Privacy Policy.

account.p: Credentials are personal and non-transferable. The clinic is responsible for managing its team’s roles and permissions (physician, front desk, billing, management) and for keeping registration data accurate.

clinical.p: Auronis produces drafts and checks to support the professional — it does not practice medicine and does not replace clinical judgment. Every AI-generated document requires review and approval by a licensed professional (human-in-the-loop) before signing or submission.

plans.p: Plans are billed per doctor/month, monthly or yearly (yearly equals 2 months free). You can cancel anytime; price changes are announced at least 30 days in advance.

ip.p: The platform, brand and models belong to Auronis Health. Clinical data belongs to the clinic and its patients; you can export it at any time.

availability.p: We use commercially reasonable efforts to keep the service available, with scheduled maintenance announced in advance and support through official channels.

liability.p: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Auronis’ liability is limited to the amounts paid in the 12 months preceding the event. Clinical and billing decisions remain the responsibility of the professionals and the clinic.

termination.p: The agreement remains in force while the subscription is active. After termination we provide data export and then delete or return data as set out in the Privacy Policy.

law.p: These terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil, with venue in São Paulo/SP, unless mandatory law provides otherwise.

lgpd.title: LGPD & data protection
lgpd.intro: Our commitment to Brazil’s General Data Protection Law (Law 13,709/2018) is structural: Auronis Health processes health data, so privacy is a product requirement — not an appendix.

commitment.p: Privacy by design: data minimization, per-clinic segregation, mandatory human review and auditing of every access to clinical data.

roles.p: The contracting clinic is the controller of patient data and defines the purposes of processing. Auronis Health acts as processor, handling data only under the clinic’s contractual instructions.

bases.p: We process data based on contract performance, protection of health in procedures carried out by health professionals (art. 11, II, f), compliance with legal obligations and, where applicable, legitimate interest — always with impact assessment.

sensitive.p: Audio, transcripts and records are sensitive data: encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS), with access restricted by role and never used to train models with patient identification.

rights.p: We uphold the rights in art. 18: confirmation, access, correction, anonymization, blocking, deletion, portability and information about sharing. Patient requests are handled together with the controller clinic.

incidents.p: We maintain an incident response plan. In case of an incident with relevant risk, we notify the affected clinic and the ANPD within regulatory deadlines.

transfer.p: When data is processed outside Brazil (e.g., cloud AI inference), we apply the safeguards of LGPD art. 33, including contractual clauses and encryption in transport.

dpo.p: Our DPO serves data subjects, clinics and the ANPD at privacidade@auronishealth.com.
